title: Parent risk
description: A harm plus the standing condition that makes it possible, written as one sentence. Resolves up to a top-level harm through an intermediate-harm term. Lists its branches.

statement.description: [who] suffers [what] because [standing condition]. If it cannot be written this way, it is not a risk.

mechanism.description: The standing condition every branch hangs from. Usually a design choice or policy, often implicit.

branches.description: The distinct paths from mechanism to harm. One is usually the governance gap.

tolerance.description: Which tolerance this parent's residual compares to. Absent = the missing-governance-input finding.

residual.description: The aggregate of branch residuals (field guide). Computed, not asserted.
